assets.prompt: Create ONE professional dark fantasy character concept sheet for a private game art bible. Presentation inspired by hand-painted dark fantasy game artbooks: precise graphite and ink construction lines, restrained opaque watercolor/gouache, worn tactile materials, pale gray parchment paper, ample negative space, sober haunting atmosphere, realistic adult human proportions. Full head-to-toe figure fully inside frame, readable footwear, 3/4 neutral standing pose, plus two small material/face detail studies to the side. This is a design proposal based on an existing pixel sprite, not a new palette design. Preserve reference silhouette, garment hierarchy, hair color and exact broad palette; expand details conservatively. No titles, no written text, no labels, no watermark, no logos, no scenic background, no enemies or extra characters, no UI, no cropped feet. Portrait canvas. SUBJECT: Red Riding Hood, explicitly an adult young woman with youthful face. Reference 1 is her current sprite (canonical silhouette and colors); reference 2 is an older design gallery where ONLY THE RIGHT sprite of each pair is her, left is an unrelated source. Trust current sprite for boots. Very pale skin, short-to-shoulder silver-white visible hair as in sprite, red eyes, scarlet lips. Deep oxblood red hood and cape, black LEATHER fitted corset, dark puffed BLOOMER SHORTS resembling a short voluminous skirt (must remain shorts, not a dress), long black thigh/high boots per current silhouette, no stockings/tiny shoes. One dark gray-purple withering hand with subtle dark miasma, clearly diseased rather than gloved. Conservatively follow its visible side from current sprite without inventing larger infection. Not an exposed skeleton, no mutilation gore. Small detail study of glossy deep crimson blood magic with droplets, another of hooded face. Fully clothed, nonsexual neutral stance. A simple dark red-brown wooden bow with silver string may stand alongside her. No crown, crosses, new jewelry or giant weapon.
